title: Traverse chronological BlazeFace proposals with first-20 stop

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-004 RED: no BlazeFace proposal path exists in the client, so traversal and stop probes fail; GREEN: MediaPipe BlazeFace Full-range runs in its browser runtime with a separate release-versioned model asset, a more-than-20-occurrence reference-series fixture emits proposals earliest-to-latest with preserved detector order within each frame and stops immediately at occurrence 20, a repeated-person fixture keeps every occurrence, and a model load/validation failure surfaces a recoverable operator-visible error without silently activating YuNet; decisive comparison: emitted proposal sequences are compared frame-by-frame and in-frame against the fixture ground truth, and a dependency/runtime composition scan proves no TensorFlow.js, second ML runtime, parallel YuNet or generic detector abstraction; artifact: playwright transcript, ordered proposal dumps and the composition scan under .tasks/TASK-047-T2-FT-003-W2/.
purpose: Implement the client proposal detector path: the pinned BlazeFace Full-range model asset, chronological series traversal with in-frame order preservation and the immediate first-20 stop, with recoverable load-failure behavior.
success_outcome: The client traverses one ready reference series from earliest pre-trigger to latest post-trigger, emits detector-ordered occurrences and stops immediately after occurrence 20, performing no ranking, top-5 selection, authoritative quality gating, tracking, clustering, deduplication, embeddings or search, and failing recoverably when the versioned model cannot load.
anti_goals: Do not add TensorFlow.js or another project-selected ML runtime, a parallel YuNet implementation or a generic detector abstraction; YuNet replaces BlazeFace only after concrete incompatibility.
Do not embed the model in JavaScript; it ships as a separate versioned asset of the client release.
Do not implement crop/JPEG encoding, multipart submission or trigger/ring-buffer behavior.

forbidden_scope: Crop geometry and JPEG encoding owned by TASK-048-T2-FT-003-W2
Ring buffer and trigger acceptance owned by TASK-050-T2-FT-003-W3
Multipart formation and submission owned by TASK-052-T2-FT-003-W4
Server-side selection and search owned by FT-004
stop_conditions: BlazeFace Full-range is shown technically unusable in the managed Chromium runtime, requiring the accepted sequential YuNet replacement route instead of a parallel implementation.
Chronological first-20 semantics cannot be proved without uploading full reference frames, which the contract excludes.
The versioned model asset cannot ship as a separate pinned release asset.

constraints: Use the installed Playwright CLI through `playwright cli` with harness pages driving the real browser detector runtime over deterministic frame fixtures; browser-free probes are not substitutes.
The detector is MediaPipe BlazeFace Full-range through its browser runtime only; the model is a separate pinned release-versioned asset served with the client bundle.
Fixture frames carry known face counts and positions so occurrence order and the immediate stop at 20 are decidable without uploading reference frames.
Use disposable browser profiles and fixtures with safe rerun and complete cleanup; store transcripts and proposal dumps under .tasks/TASK-047-T2-FT-003-W2/.
invariants: Traversal runs earliest-to-latest and preserves detector output order within each frame; detection stops immediately after the twentieth occurrence.
The client performs no ranking, top-5 selection, authoritative quality gating, tracking, clustering, deduplication, embeddings or commercial-photo search.
A model load or validation failure never silently activates another detector and leaves the client in recoverable advertising.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-004: a more-than-20-occurrence fixture proves earliest-to-latest traversal, preserved in-frame order, the immediate stop at occurrence 20 and emission of exactly those first 20; a repeated-person fixture proves occurrences are retained.

Dependency/runtime composition scan proves the MediaPipe browser runtime, the separate versioned model asset and the absence of TensorFlow.js, a second ML runtime, parallel YuNet and detector abstractions.
Model load/validation failure injection proves recoverable operator-visible feedback with advertising preserved and no silent fallback.
